configuration.cpu_profile: Sequential diagnostic; AVX2/FMA/F16C, GGML_NATIVE=OFF, CPU-only, app threads cap=6
configuration.mode: one persistent app worker, first request cold, later requests warm unless restarted
configuration.decoder: app final beam=5, temperature=0, fallback increment=0.2, no translation/context/prompt
configuration.normalization: NFC + Unicode punctuation to spaces + whitespace; digits/spelling not rewritten
configuration.cer: Unicode scalar values including normalized spaces, not graphemes
